criteria.text: A source file above 10,485,760 bytes is refused before its contents are read, including a raw file replaced for upload.
A selected payload above 10,000 files or 10,485,760 total bytes is refused before reading the selection that exceeds its limit.
A shared record graph that would expand beyond 10,485,760 bytes stops during expansion with a finite too-big error and no upload.
A normal source and a source exactly at the read or expansion boundary remain eligible for the existing later validation and tar limits.

cases.given: small valid prompt/scenario and two shared records through sourceFilePort, readPrompt, captureSource and prepareSource readFile
cases.required_observation: normal bytes/provenance retained; synchronous entry still synchronous; native read spy sees only safe inputs

cases.given: synthetic selected dependency with sparse size 2147483649 bytes; separately 10485761-byte target through sourceFilePort, readPrompt and capture; separately oversized raw path replaced by prepareSource output
cases.required_observation: finite exit-4 too-big report before any native open/read of oversized path; no RangeError; resolver direct fake stat above limit gives contract-invalid before files.read; no upload/auth/model calls

cases.given: two selected files with stat sizes 6291456 and 4194305 bytes; separately 10001 selected small paths; repeat an already selected path; separate reference-only inputs totaling above 10MiB with small selected leaf results
cases.required_observation: selected over-budget set refuses before its overflow read; repeated selected path counted once; total and largest files reported without contents; unselected reference raw totals alone do not refuse a fitting selected payload

cases.given: synthetic eight-way schema reference DAG, seven levels, tiny authored files; projected fully expanded graph exceeds 10MiB; an early fitting branch and later overflowing branch; run public expandSource and captureSource
cases.required_observation: contract-invalid finite too-big error naming originating consumer/target; halt during branch expansion before any oversized intermediate value/snapshot/text allocation; no successful partial result or upload; no time-based pass criterion

cases.given: synthetic valid JSON source/record encoded to 10485759,10485760,10485761 UTF-8 bytes using padding within a string; repeat with multibyte text
cases.required_observation: first two fit read/expanded-value byte budget, last refuses; count UTF-8 bytes, not character count; separate aggregate effective-source and tar limits still apply

cases.given: 9999,10000,10001 unique selected small paths within byte budget, plus repeated selection of a previous path
cases.required_observation: first two fit selected-file count, 10001 refuses before selected read; repeated selected paths do not consume another count; no expanded or generated output bypasses selected limits

cases.given: valid small selected program plus unrelated 12582912-byte transcript under user_stories; repeat with a sparse 2147483649-byte ignored Markdown document and a catalog-only oversized document; exercise Check/Try capture and local contract list/sync preview with read/auth/transport spies.
cases.required_observation: oversized non-upload discovery/catalog content skipped or warned before open/read/allocation; selected good work remains eligible and no ignored file is uploaded/counted; unavailable catalog/footprint evidence is explicit rather than fabricated; local contracts makes no auth/network/model call

cases.given: selected good Story A test and unselected A sibling whose dependency document is 12582912 bytes; then select that same dependency through the good test.
cases.required_observation: unselected sibling footprint unavailable without blocking good selected capture or reading huge content; when required by selected work, stat-before-read exit-4 too-big refusal remains and no upload/auth/model call occurs

cases.given: depth-400 fitting object schema with one small contract reference near the beginning and ordinary schema nodes after it; repeat a cached target with differing local annotations; preserve written key order and exact number 9007199254740993.
cases.required_observation: exact expansion/provenance succeeds; account expanded size once per reference result rather than full-subtree size walks per ordinary enclosing node; annotations remain independent, bytes/numbers/order unchanged; existing early fanout/overflow refusals still apply; no wall-clock pass threshold
